source:
一阵冰冷的风形成一条120尺长，20尺宽的线状区域，在法术持续时间内从你的位置吹向你选择的方向。每一个在该线状区域中开始其回合生物必须通过一次力量豁免，否则将被你推离30尺。豁免失败的生物也会受到1d12点寒冷伤害并应击倒地。如果在寒冷天气或是黑暗或阴影的状态下施展，豁免将处于劣势。该区域中的任何生物在靠近你时每移动1尺，就必须消耗2尺的移动力。
在法术结束前的每个回合，你都可以一个附赠动作，改变线状区域从你身上喷出的方向。
刺骨寒风会吹散气体或蒸汽，它会熄灭该区域的蜡烛、火把、灯笼和类似的火焰。
升环施法。当你用四环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，豁免具有劣势，并且每比三环高一环，伤害增加1d12点。
target:
An icy wind forms a line 120 feet long and 20 feet wide, blowing from your position in a direction you choose for the duration. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 30 feet away from you, take 1d12 Cold damage, and fall Prone. If the spell is cast in cold weather, darkness, or shadow, the save has Disadvantage. A creature in the area must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves toward you.
On each turn before the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action to change the direction in which the line blows from you.
The bitter wind disperses gas or vapor and extinguishes candles, torches, lanterns, and similar flames in the area.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of fourth level or higher, the saving throw has Disadvantage, and the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above third.
note: The failed-save push, damage and Prone condition remain in one branch. Weather/light-dependent Disadvantage and the separate higher-slot Disadvantage are both retained, along with movement cost and flame/gas effects.

source:
你将暗影物质绑定至一条附魔的妖精之路上，固定两点之间的道路，以抵御普通天气和世俗的变化，并在暗影潮汐中伸展和弯曲。这被称为暗影之路，它会受到正常的磨损，会被那些有工具的人破坏，也会被敌对力量的魔法破坏，比如解除魔法Dispel Magic 。
如果你愿意，法术可以包含一个祷词或祭品作为关键词。这条道路的秘密允许任何知道并使用它的人在道路上添加一到两个效果，例如在道路上更快地行走（最高可达到通常允许的陆上速度的两倍）或锁定和解锁影域Shadow Realm之外的道路。那些不知道祷词、仪式或祭品的人不能从影域之外进入这条路。
context: column:M;spell:Deep Roots of the Moon;book:黯潮之书;level:3
target:
You bind shadow-stuff to an enchanted Fey road, anchoring the road between two points against ordinary weather and mundane changes while it stretches and bends in the tides of shadow. Known as a shadow road, it is subject to normal wear and tear, can be damaged by those with tools, and can be destroyed by hostile magic such as Dispel Magic.
If you wish, the spell can include a prayer or offering as a keyword. This secret of the road lets anyone who knows and uses it add one or two effects to the road, such as traveling along it faster, up to twice the normally allowed overland speed, or locking and unlocking the road from outside the Shadow Realm. Those who do not know the prayer, ritual, or offering cannot enter the road from outside the Shadow Realm.
note: The unusual prayer-or-offering keyword and the road's stretch/anchor description are translated as supplied. One-or-two effects, the doubled-speed limit and outside-Shadow-Realm access restriction are retained; no unstated ritual mechanics are invented.

source:
你和最多五个其他生物向妖精王庭的领主和女领主们敬酒。从以下祝酒词中选择之一，目标必须在施法过程中距离你10尺内。
惺惺相惜Commiseration。施法者可以组建或加入一个鬼婆集会。在集会中，每个成员之间可以共享法术位。法术持续期间，鬼婆集会中一名成员知晓的法术所有成员都会知晓，并且可以使用任何共享的法术位施展。
友谊Friendship。每个参加祝酒会的生物在法术持续时间内变成妖精生物，取代他们原来的生物类型，当他们处于影域或曙光之地Bright Lands时，他们的地位status*会增加 2d6。 （见第一章[不全书暂无]）
畜牧Husbandry。在法术持续时间内，参与者可以与野兽交流，就像他们有共通的语言一样（尽管他们不会获得影响野兽的魔法能力）。
噩梦Nightmares。 在法术持续时间内，生物首次靠近其中一名参与者30尺内时，它必须通过一次感知豁免，否则会在1分钟内对所有参与者恐慌。
嬉戏Playfulness。 每个参与者都会长出翅膀，并在持续时间内的10轮内，他们会获得等同于步行速度的飞行速度。如果参与者在回合结束时没有站在水平面上，回合结束时就会倒地。
宁静Restfulness。 每个参与者在法术持续时间内在对抗魅惑或陷入睡眠的法术或其他魔法效应时具有优势。
target:
You and up to five other creatures drink a toast to the lords and ladies of the Fey courts. Choose one of the following toasts. The targets must be within 10 feet of you during the casting.
Commiseration. The caster can form or join a hag coven. Members of the coven can share spell slots with one another. For the duration, every member knows the spells known by any one member and can cast them using any shared spell slot.
Friendship. Each creature participating in the toast becomes a Fey for the duration, replacing its original creature type. While in the Shadow Realm or the Bright Lands, its status* increases by 2d6. (See chapter one [not currently included in this compilation].)
Husbandry. For the duration, participants can communicate with Beasts as though they shared a language, although they gain no magical ability to influence Beasts.
Nightmares. For the duration, when a creature first comes within 30 feet of one of the participants, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened of all participants for 1 minute.
Playfulness. Each participant grows wings and gains a flying speed equal to its walking speed for 10 rounds during the duration. If a participant is not standing on a level surface at the end of its turn, it falls Prone at the end of that turn.
Restfulness. For the duration, each participant has Advantage against spells or other magical effects that charm it or put it to sleep.
note: All six toasts share the caster-plus-five count and within-10-foot casting prerequisite. The source's unavailable chapter/status reference, ten-round flight and unusual end-turn Prone wording are retained. Restfulness does not identify a roll type, so no saving-throw wording is silently added.

source:
你选择施法距离内地面可见一点，尖锐的矛状阴影覆盖地面15尺立方的区域。 在法术持续时间内，这些阴影会遮蔽该范围内的生物，为他们提供半身掩护。当生物在一个回合中首次进入受影响的区域或在其中开始其回合时，该生物必须通过一次敏捷豁免，否则会受到1d8点穿透伤害并目盲，直到法术结束。
在该区域开始回合的生物如果已经目盲会受到1d8点穿刺伤害。
因暗影目盲的生物可以使用其动作进行一次敏捷或感知豁免（由其选择）以对抗你的法术豁免DC。如果成功，它则恢复视力。
target:
Choose a point on the ground you can see within range. Sharp, spear-like shadows cover the ground in a 15-foot Cube. For the duration, they conceal creatures in the area, providing Half Cover. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Piercing damage and be Blinded until the spell ends.
A creature that starts its turn in the area while already Blinded takes 1d8 Piercing damage.
A creature Blinded by the shadows can use its action to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw, its choice, against your spell save DC. On a success, it regains its sight.
note: All cover, two damage cases and action-based escape save choices remain. The source uses two Chinese terms for piercing damage in the two sentences; both are rendered Piercing without altering the damage type.

source:
你试图迷惑一个生物的方向感。目标必须进行一次感知豁免，如果豁免失败，则法术会消除所有关于特定地点的记忆、地标和路线的记忆——即使是众所周知的地点，如城市内的地点、 森林之家、著名的山丘和道路。
移除诅咒Remove Curse或高等复原术Greater Restoration 会终止此效果。
升环施法。当你使用四环或更高的法术位施放此法术时，每比三环高一环便可额外指定一名生物为目标。这些生物必须相距在30尺内。如果你使用五环或更高环阶的法术位，法术持续时间变为8小时。七环改为24小时。如果你使用9环法术位施展该法术，法术持续时间变为直到被解除。
target:
You try to confuse a creature's sense of direction. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the spell erases all memories of particular places, landmarks, and routes, even well-known places such as locations in a city, a forest home, or famous hills and roads.
Remove Curse or Greater Restoration ends this effect.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of fourth level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above third. The creatures must be within 30 feet of one another. With a slot of fifth level or higher, the duration becomes 8 hours; at seventh level, it becomes 24 hours. With a level 9 spell slot, the duration becomes until dispelled.
note: The complete memory examples and both remedies remain. Extra-target spacing and the source's fifth-or-higher/eighth-hour, seventh-level/24-hour and ninth-level/until-dispelled wording are retained without inventing a missing threshold clause.

source: 如果你豁免失败，你可以选择改为成功。然后选择距离你30尺内的一可见生物，令其受到你豁免失败的效应的影响，目标可以对此进行豁免，如同它是豁免的原始目标一样，但该豁免具有劣势。你仍会受到豁免成功的效果（若有）。
context: column:M;spell:Orros Mark of Fate;book:黯潮之书;level:3
target: If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead. Then choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you to suffer the effects of your failed save. The target can make a saving throw as though it were the original target, but that save has Disadvantage. You still suffer any effects of a successful save.
note: The failed-to-success replacement, visible target and distance, transferred failure effects, target's disadvantaged save and residual successful-save effects are all preserved.

source:
你可以在最近的墙壁、悬崖、树木或类似结构上创建一扇门。它将立即与200尺内的一处相似的门相连。近处的门必须在10尺内，而远处的门可以是你可以看到的地方，也可以是您可以通过说明距离和方向来描述的地方，例如向正下100尺或西北向上45度50尺。
咒唤出门后，你可以以动作打开并通过近处的传送门，这会立即将你传送到远处的传送门。其他生物也可以这样做，直到法术持续时间结束或当有人以一个附赠动作将远处的门关闭后结束。
升环施法。如果以五环法术位施展该法术，此法术可以打开通往暗影之路shadow road的门。 这可能需要 额外的姿势或材料成分。 如果缺少这些成分，法术就会失效并被浪费。
target:
You can create a door on the nearest wall, cliff, tree, or similar structure. It immediately connects to a similar door within 200 feet. The near door must be within 10 feet, while the far door can be at a place you can see or one you can describe by distance and direction, such as 100 feet straight down or 50 feet to the northwest at a 45-degree upward angle.
Once you conjure the doors, you can use an action to open and pass through the near portal, instantly transporting you to the far portal. Other creatures can do the same until the duration ends or someone closes the far door as a Bonus Action, ending the spell.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: With a fifth-level spell slot, the spell can open a door to a shadow road. This might require additional Somatic or Material components. If these are missing, the spell fails and is wasted.
note: Both portal distances, complete directional examples, action passage and anyone's far-door Bonus Action closure are retained. The source gives exactly a fifth-level slot for shadow-road access; no or-higher clause is added, and the unspecified extra components remain unspecified.

source:
雷鸣般的巨声于法术持续时间内回响在源自你的半径10尺的光环区域。每当光环区域进入一名你可见生物所在的空间时、一名你可见的生物进入光环区域或是在该区域结束其回合时，该生物都要进行一次体质豁免检定。失败则该生物受到3d6雷鸣伤害且陷入耳聋状态，持续至你的下一回合开始。豁免成功则仅受半伤。一名生物一回合只进行一次该豁免。你在施展该法术时可以指定哪些生物不受其影响。
此外，你获得对雷鸣伤害的抗性，且对你发动的远程攻击检定均具有劣势。
升环施法。你使用的法术位每比三环高一环，法术的伤害就增加1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Cacophonic Shield;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:3
target:
A thunderous noise echoes for the duration through an Emanation with a radius of 10 feet originating from you. Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see, or a creature you can see enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 Thunder damage and is Deafened until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected.
You also gain Resistance to Thunder damage, and ranged attack rolls against you have Disadvantage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above third.
note: The visible-creature triggers, exemptions, once-per-turn save, failed-save-only Deafened duration, Thunder Resistance and all ranged attacks rather than only weapon attacks are retained.

source:
你咒唤一群无形且守序的灵体，其于施法距离内的一处未占据空间中显现为中型的、由一队魔冢或其它构装组成的机群。机群存在直至法术结束。
当你施展该法术时、或是在后续回合中以一个魔法动作，你可以令机群指定其5尺内的一个生物或物件，创造下列效果之一：
机关之力Clockwork Force。目标进行一次敏捷豁免检定，豁免失败受3d6力场伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
秩序守护Orderly Ward。目标获得等于1d6+你的施法属性调整值点临时生命值。
当你在你的回合移动时，你可以令机群也移动至多30尺到一处你可见的未占据空间中。
升环施法。你使用的法术位每比三环高一环，法术的伤害和临时生命值就增加1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Conjure Constructs;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:3
target:
You conjure a group of incorporeal, lawful spirits that appear in an unoccupied space within range as a Medium swarm of Modrons or other Constructs. The swarm remains until the spell ends.
When you cast the spell, or as a Magic action on a later turn, you can have the swarm target a creature or object within 5 feet of it to produce one of the following effects:
Clockwork Force. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Force damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
Orderly Ward. The target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
When you move on your turn, you can also move the swarm up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage and Temporary Hit Points each increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Both effects share the initial-cast/later-Magic-action and within-5-foot creature-or-object targeting prerequisites. The source does not exclude objects from Orderly Ward or require visibility for the initial summoning space; neither restriction is added.

source:
银色能量自你之处爆发，覆盖一处120尺长、5尺宽的线状区域。每名位于区域内的由你选择的生物都进行一次力量豁免检定。豁免失败者受到3d10力场伤害且陷入倒地状态。豁免成功仅受半伤。
升环施法。你使用的法术位每比三环高一环，法术的伤害就增加1d10。
context: column:M;spell:Laeral's Silver Lance;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:3
target:
Silver energy bursts from you in a line 120 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature you choose in the area makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d10 Force damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above third.
note: The selected-creature scope, line dimensions, failed-save-only Prone condition and damage scaling are fully retained.

source:
一条闪烁的灵体毒蛇将于法术的持续时间内环绕在你的身侧。你获得15点临时生命值；此法术会在你不具有剩余的临时生命值时提前结束。
你在此法术生效期间获得以下增益：
攀援Climbing。你获得等于你速度的攀爬速度。
剧毒啃咬Venomous Bite。以一个魔法动作，你能用这条毒蛇对50尺内的一名生物发动一次远程法术攻击。若命中，则目标受到1d6力场伤害且陷入中毒状态直至你的下一回合开始。目标还会在中毒期间陷入失能状态。
升环施法。你使用的法术位每比三环高一环，你从法术获得的临时生命值就增加5，且剧毒啃咬的伤害也增加1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Sylune's Viper;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:3
target:
A shimmering spectral viper coils beside you for the duration. You gain 15 Temporary Hit Points. This spell ends early when you have no Temporary Hit Points remaining.
You gain the following benefits while the spell is active:
Climbing. You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
Venomous Bite. As a Magic action, you can use the viper to make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 50 feet. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 Force damage and is Poisoned until the start of your next turn. While Poisoned, it is also Incapacitated.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The Temporary Hit Points you gain increase by 5, and Venomous Bite's damage increases by 1d6, for each spell slot level above third.
note: All Temporary Hit Point timing, climbing, ranged spell attack and both scaling benefits are preserved. Incapacitated stays conditional on Poisoned; the source's ending says no remaining Temporary Hit Points without limiting that clause to this spell's points.

source:
你在施法距离内创造出一个漂浮在空中，不受伤害的隐形魔法眼。你通过精神连接接收秘法眼传来的视觉信息。秘法眼拥有30尺黑暗视觉且可以观察任何方向。
以一个附赠动作，你可以让秘法眼向任意方向移动30尺。固体障碍物会阻挡秘法眼的移动，但它可以穿过任何直径大于1寸的缝隙。
target:
You create an invisible magical eye within range. It floats in the air and cannot be harmed. You mentally receive visual information from it. The eye has Darkvision out to 30 feet and can look in any direction.
As a Bonus Action, you can move the eye 30 feet in any direction. Solid barriers block its movement, but it can pass through any gap with a diameter greater than 1 cun.
note: The Bonus Action, movement distance, all-direction vision and Darkvision are retained. The source explicitly says a diameter greater than bare 1 cun; both that comparison and the untranslated unit are preserved pending unit review.

source:
一个在你施法距离内你可见的生物必须进行一次魅力豁免，豁免失败者会在法术持续期间被转移到一个无害的半位面，身处半位面期间，目标会陷入失能状态。当法术终止时，目标将重新出现在其被放逐前的位置。如果该位置被占据，则目标将出现在距离该位置最近的一个未被占据空间。
若该目标的生物类型为异怪、天族、元素、妖精或邪魔，则在法术持续一分钟后，目标不会返回。该目标会被改为转移到与其生物类型相关的一个位面（由DM决定）中的随机地点。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，你就能多指定一个生物作为此法术的目标。
target:
One creature you can see within range must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it is transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While in that demiplane, the target has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left. If that space is occupied, it appears in the nearest unoccupied space.
If the target is an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend, it does not return after the spell has lasted for 1 minute. Instead, it is transported to a random location on a plane associated with its creature type, as determined by the DM.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; the one-minute creature-type exception and random destination are preserved from this source.

source:
一个在你施法距离内你可见的生物必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败者受到8d8黯蚀伤害，成功则只受到一半伤害。生物类型为植物的生物在此豁免中自动失败。
作为此法术的另一种用法，你可以指定一个并非生物的非魔法植物为目标（如树木或灌木），该植物不进行豁免，直接凋谢死亡。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，此法术的伤害就提升1d8。
target:
One creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature of the Plant type automatically fails this save.
Alternatively, you can target a nonmagical plant that is not a creature, such as a tree or shrub. The plant makes no saving throw; it simply withers and dies.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; the automatic failure for Plant creatures and separate noncreature-plant option remain distinct.

source:
一名你可见的施法距离内的生物进行一次感知豁免，如果你或者你的盟友正在与它战斗，它在这次豁免上具有优势。豁免失败，则目标陷入魅惑状态直至法术结束，或在你或你的盟友对它造成伤害时提前结束。魅惑生物将对你友好。当法术结束时，目标会知道它曾被你魅惑。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，你就可以额外指定一名生物作为此法术的目标。
target:
One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw, with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends, ending early if you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly toward you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; combat Advantage, early termination on damage, and the target learning of the charm are retained.

source:
每名你所选择的，施法距离内你可见的生物必须成功通过一次感知豁免，否则陷入魅惑状态直至法术结束。
法术持续期间，你能够以一个附赠动作指向你的某个水平方向。随后，每个魅惑目标在其下一回合里必须使用其所有的移动力，采取最安全的路线，尽可能的向该方向移动。在以此法移动后，目标可以重新豁免，豁免成功则结束其身上该法术的效应。
target:
Each creature you choose that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition until the spell ends.
For the duration, you can take a Bonus Action to point in a horizontal direction from yourself. On its next turn, each Charmed target must then use all its movement to travel as far as possible in that direction by the safest route. After moving in this way, the target can repeat the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
note: Full passage translated; horizontal direction, all movement, safest route, and the repeat save after movement are retained.

source:
你选择施法距离内一点为中心，半径10尺球状区域内的每名生物必须成功通过一次感知豁免，否则目标不能执行反应和附赠动作，并且必须在其每个回合开始时掷1d10，根据下表内容来决定当回合的行为。

1d10 当前回合行为 
1 目标不执行任何动作，并使用所有移动力来进行移动。掷 1d4 决定其方向：1.北、2.东、3.南、4.西。 
2~6 目标不进行移动也不执行任何动作。 
7~8 该生物不进行移动，执行动作来对其触及内一名随机生物发动一次近战攻击。如果没有生物在其触及内，则目标本回合不执行任何动作。 
9~10 该生物自行决定当回合行为。受影响的目标在其每回合结束时都可以重新豁免，豁免成功则结束其身上该法术的效应。 

升环施法： 使用的法术位每比四环高一环，此法术的球状区域半径就增加5尺。
target:
Choose a point within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take Reactions or Bonus Actions. An affected target must also roll 1d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn from the table below.

1d10 | Behavior This Turn
1 | The target takes no actions and uses all its movement to move. Roll 1d4 to determine the direction: 1, north; 2, east; 3, south; 4, west.
2-6 | The target neither moves nor takes any actions.
7-8 | The creature does not move and uses its action to make one melee attack against a random creature within its reach. If no creature is within its reach, the target takes no actions this turn.
9-10 | The creature chooses its own behavior for the turn.
An affected target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The Sphere's radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4.
note: All four table rows and direction results translated. The source appends the general end-of-turn repeat-save rule to the last row; it is separated here because its subject is every affected target, not only that row.

source:
你在持续时间内将来自元素位面的精魂咒唤在你身周15尺光环区域内，让它们环绕着你飞舞。直到法术结束为止，你进行的任何攻击检定命中光环区域内的生物时，都会额外造成2d8点伤害。额外伤害的类型为强酸、寒冷、火焰或闪电的一种（在你发动攻击时选择）。
此外，光环区域内的地面对你的敌人而言是困难地形。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比四环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加2d8。
target:
For the duration, you conjure spirits from the Elemental Planes that swirl around you in a 15-foot Emanation. Until the spell ends, whenever any attack roll you make hits a creature within the Emanation, the attack deals an extra 2d8 damage. This extra damage is Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage, chosen when you make the attack.
In addition, the ground within the Emanation is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 2d8 for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated exactly as supplied, including the 2d8-per-slot increase; no rules update or other edition is substituted.

source:
你在持续时间内将许多自然精魂咒唤在你身周10尺光环区域内。每当光环区域进入一名你可见生物所在的空间时、一名你可见的生物进入光环区域或是在该区域结束其回合时，你都可以迫使该生物进行一次感知豁免检定。失败则该生物受到5d8点力场伤害，成功则只受一半伤害。一名生物一回合只需要进行一次该豁免。
此外，在持续时间内，你能够以附赠动作执行撤离动作。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d8。
target:
For the duration, you conjure many nature spirits in a 10-foot Emanation around yourself. Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see, a creature you can see enters the Emanation, or such a creature ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. It takes 5d8 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature needs to make this save only once per turn.
In addition, for the duration, you can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; all three visible-creature triggers, the optional save, and the once-per-turn limit are retained.

source:
你控制你指定的一处边长至多100尺的立方区域中的任意水体直至法术结束，从以下效应中选择其一生效。在后续的你的回合中，你能够以一个魔法动作重复同一效应，或是选择另一效应。
　　• 上涨Flood。你使控制区域内的水位上涨20尺。如果你指定的区域是一片大水体中的一部分，则你改为制造一片20尺高的波浪，并在从区域的一边扑向另一边后崩溃。波浪中任何巨型或更小的载具都会被波浪带到区域的另一边。且所有巨型或更小的载具都有25%的几率倾覆。
直至法术结束或你选择另一个效应，水位将维持上涨。如果该效应用以产生波浪，则你维持上涨期间，波浪在你的回合开始时重新出现。
　　• 分水Part Water。你使区域内的水体分开并形成一条水体的沟壑。沟壑从法术区域的一头延伸到另一头，而被分开的水体则在两边形成两道水墙。沟壑持续存在，直至法术结束或你选择另一个效应。该效应终止时，水流会在下一轮中逐渐将沟壑填满，直至其恢复成通常的水位。
　　• 转向Redirect Flow。你使区域内的流水向一个你自选的方向流动，即使水流需要绕过障碍、沿着墙壁向上流、或是流向一些不太可能的方向，区域内的水体都将遵照你指使的方向流动，但一旦其流出法术区域，则会重新基于其所在地形改变流向。水体持续向你所选方向流动，直至法术结束或你选择另一个效应。
　　• 漩涡Whirlpool。该效应需要水体至少为50尺的方形区域并且至少有25尺深。你在区域中央形成一个漩涡。漩涡持续存在，直至法术结束或你选择另一个效应。漩涡的形态为底部宽5尺，顶部至多宽50尺，高25尺。水中任何位于漩涡25尺内的生物或物件均被漩涡向自身拉动10尺。当一名生物在一个回合内第一次进入漩涡或在漩涡内结束其回合时，进行一次力量豁免。豁免失败受到2d8点钝击伤害。豁免成功则只受一半伤害。一名生物若想以游泳方式离开漩涡，则必须先执行一个动作来远离漩涡并成功通过一次对抗你法术豁免DC的力量（运动）检定。
target:
Until the spell ends, you control any water in a Cube you designate, up to 100 feet on a side. Choose one of the following effects. On your later turns, you can take a Magic action to repeat the same effect or choose another one.
• Flood. You raise the water level in the area by 20 feet. If the designated area is part of a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot-high wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then collapses. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave are carried to the other side of the area, and all Huge or smaller vehicles have a 25 percent chance of capsizing.
The water level remains raised until the spell ends or you choose another effect. If this effect creates a wave, the wave reappears at the start of your turn for as long as you maintain Flood.
• Part Water. You part the water in the area to form a trench. The trench extends from one end of the spell's area to the other, with the parted water forming a wall on each side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose another effect. When this effect ends, water gradually fills the trench over the next round until it reaches its normal level.
• Redirect Flow. You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if it must go around obstacles, flow up walls, or move in other unlikely directions. Water in the area flows as you direct, but once it leaves the spell's area, it changes direction according to the terrain. The water continues flowing in your chosen direction until the spell ends or you choose another effect.
• Whirlpool. This effect requires water in an area at least 50 feet square and at least 25 feet deep. You create a whirlpool in the center of the area. It lasts until the spell ends or you choose another effect. The whirlpool is 5 feet wide at the bottom, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet high. Any creature or object in the water within 25 feet of the whirlpool is pulled 10 feet toward it. When a creature enters the whirlpool for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Strength saving throw, taking 2d8 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. To swim out of the whirlpool, a creature must first take an action to move away from it and succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC.
note: All four modes translated in full, including vehicle size and capsizing chance, the next-round refill, and the action plus check needed to swim out. Original rich-text formatting remains a separate workbook dependency.

source:
你触摸一名生物，并给予其对死亡的防护。在法术结束前，当目标的生命值首次降至0时，该目标的生命值改为降至1，随后法术终止。
目标受到直接致死而不造成伤害的效应影响时，若该法术仍在生效，则改为目标受到的致死效应失效，随后法术终止。
target:
You touch a creature and grant it protection from death. The first time its Hit Points drop to 0 before the spell ends, they drop to 1 instead, and the spell then ends.
If the target is subjected to an effect that kills it instantly without dealing damage while this spell is still active, that lethal effect is negated instead, and the spell then ends.
note: Full passage translated. The source does not restrict the first 0-Hit-Point trigger to damage, so no such qualifier is added.

source:
你将传送至施法距离内的一处地点。你会准确到达该目的地。法术的目的地可以是你能看见的、可想象的地点，也可以是通过距离和方向说明的地点，比如“径直向下200尺”，“西北偏上45度300尺”。
你还可以带上一名自愿生物一同传送。该生物在你传送时必须距你5尺内，且其传送终点也位于你所选目的地的5尺内。
如果你、你携带的生物、或两者均将被传送至一处已被一名生物占据、或被一个或更多物件填满的空间中，则你和任何与你一起传送的生物都将受到4d6点力场伤害，且传送失败。
target:
You teleport to a location within range, arriving exactly at that destination. It can be a place you can see, a place you can visualize, or a place you describe by distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight down" or "300 feet northwest at an upward angle of 45 degrees."
You can bring one willing creature with you. That creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and its destination must be within 5 feet of your chosen destination.
If you, the creature accompanying you, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or filled by one or more objects, you and any creature teleporting with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.
note: Full passage translated; both origin and destination distances and the shared failure damage are preserved. No size or carrying restriction absent from this source is added.

source:
此法术让你得以与一名神祇或其仆人取得联络。你可以就某个未来7日内将要发生的特定目标、事件或活动提出一个问题。DM将给予你真实的答复，这个答复可能是一段短语或一节神秘的短诗。此法术的回答并不会顾及所有可能影响结果的情况。例如其他法术的影响。
若你在完成一次长休前施展多于一次该法术，则法术有概率不给出任何结果。此概率从第二次施展起每次累计25％。
target:
This spell lets you contact a deity or one of its servants. You can ask one question about a specific goal, event, or activity that will occur within the next 7 days. The DM gives you a truthful answer, which might be a short phrase or a cryptic verse. The answer does not account for every circumstance that could affect the outcome, such as the effects of other spells.
If you cast this spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a chance that it gives no result. This chance increases cumulatively by 25 percent for each casting after the first.
note: Full passage translated; repeated casting can yield no answer according to this source, not a false answer.

source:
一名法术范围内你可见的野兽必须成功于一次感知豁免，否则在持续时间内陷入魅惑状态。若你或你的盟友正在与其战斗，则目标进行的此次豁免具有优势。目标受到伤害时，可以重复进行豁免，豁免成功则其身上的此法术终止。
该野兽被魅惑期间，只要你与其处于同一位面就可以与之保持心灵感应。在你的回合，你可以通过心灵感应命令该生物（无需动作），比如“攻击那个生物”“跑到那个位置”或是“去拿那个物品”。该生物会在其回合内尽其所能以遵守你的指令。生物完成一项指令却未收到你的进一步指示时，将会凭自身喜好行动，尽可能的保护自己。
你可以用自己的反应去要求目标执行一项反应。
升环施法： 使用更高环阶法术位施展时，你的专注能持续更长时间，五环至多10分钟，六环至多1小时，七环及以上至多8小时。
target:
One Beast you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or your allies are fighting it, it has Advantage on this save. Whenever the target takes damage, it can repeat the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
While the Beast is Charmed, you can maintain telepathic contact with it as long as you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can give it telepathic commands without taking an action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run to that location," or "Fetch that object." The creature does its best to obey your commands on its turn. If it completes a command and receives no further instructions, it acts as it pleases, protecting itself as best it can.
You can use your Reaction to require the target to take a Reaction.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Your Concentration can last longer when you use a higher-level slot: up to 10 minutes with a level 5 slot, 1 hour with a level 6 slot, or 8 hours with a level 7 or higher slot.
note: Full passage translated; command timing, damage-triggered repeat saves, reaction use, and all three higher-slot durations were checked against this source.

source:
蠕动的乌黑触须填满了一处施法距离内你可见的20尺方状地面。在法术持续时间内，这些触手会将此区域地面变为困难地形。
每名区域内的生物进行一次力量豁免。豁免失败受到3d6点钝击伤害，并且直到法术结束为止陷入束缚状态。一名进入此区域或在区域内结束回合的生物也要进行此豁免。一名生物一回合只进行一次此豁免。
一名被束缚的生物可以用一个动作进行一次力量（运动）检定对抗你的法术豁免DC，若检定成功则结束其身上的束缚状态。
target:
Writhing black tentacles fill a 20-foot square of ground that you can see within range. For the duration, the tentacles make the ground in the area Difficult Terrain.
Each creature in the area makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 Bludgeoning damage and has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there also makes this save. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, ending the Restrained condition on itself on a success.
note: Full passage translated; damage and restraint are both confined to the failed save, with all entry and turn-end triggers retained.

source:
你将一种原材料转化成该材料制作的成品。例如，你可以将一丛树木转化为一座木桥，一把麻草化为绳子，或是将亚麻和羊毛化作衣物。
指定施法距离内你能看见的原材料。只要有足够的材料，你就可以将他们转化为一件体型不超过大型的物件（至多占据10尺立方区域或八个相邻的5尺立方区域）。如果你的目标材料是金属、石料或者其他矿石材料，那么被制造的物件不能大于中型（至多占据 5 尺立方区域），制成品的质量和原材料质量相同。
该法术不能创造生物或魔法物品。你只有对制作某物品的工匠工具拥有熟练项时，才能使用此法术去制作相应需要高工艺水平制作的物品，如武器、护甲等。
target:
You convert raw materials into finished products made of the same material. For example, you can turn a stand of trees into a wooden bridge, a handful of hemp into rope, or flax and wool into clothing.
Choose raw materials you can see within range. Given enough material, you can turn them into one Large or smaller object, occupying no more than a 10-foot Cube or eight connected 5-foot Cubes. If the material is metal, stone, or another mineral, the object can be no larger than Medium, occupying no more than a 5-foot Cube. The finished product's quality matches that of the raw materials.
The spell cannot create creatures or magic items. You can use it to make items that require a high degree of craftsmanship, such as weapons or armor, only if you have proficiency with the Artisan's Tools used to make those items.
note: Full passage translated; the source contrasts one 10-foot cube with eight adjacent 5-foot cubes, supporting side-length rather than volume wording. Material limits and tool proficiency remain intact.

source:
轻薄缥缈的火焰在法术持续期间环绕着你的身体，散发出10尺半径的明亮光照和额外10尺的微光光照。
这层火焰可以为你提供一面温暖护盾或冻寒护盾，由你选择。温暖护盾将赋予你对冷冻伤害的抗性，而冻寒护盾则会赋予你对火焰伤害的抗性。
此外，每当一名距你5尺内的生物以一次近战攻击命中你时，这个护盾将迸发出火焰。温暖护盾将对攻击者造成2d8点火焰伤害，冻寒护盾将对攻击者造成2d8点冷冻伤害。
target:
Thin, wispy flames surround your body for the duration, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
The flames provide either a warm shield or a chill shield, your choice. The warm shield grants Resistance to Cold damage, and the chill shield grants Resistance to Fire damage.
Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the shield also erupts in flames. The warm shield deals 2d8 Fire damage to the attacker, or the chill shield deals 2d8 Cold damage to it.
note: Full passage translated; resistance and retaliation damage use opposite temperature types as in the source.

source:
一道冷冽光芒在法术持续时间内缭绕你身，散发出20尺半径的明亮光照和额外20尺的微光光照。
直到法术结束，你具有光耀伤害的抗性，并且你的近战攻击在命中时额外造成2d6点光耀伤害。
此外，在你受到距你60尺内一名你可见的生物的伤害后，你可以立即用一个反应，强迫其进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者直到你的下个回合结束为止陷入目盲状态。
target:
A cool light surrounds you for the duration, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.
Until the spell ends, you have Resistance to Radiant damage, and your melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 Radiant damage on a hit.
In addition, immediately after you take damage from a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to force it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.
note: Full passage translated; the reaction follows damage from a visible creature within 60 feet, and blindness lasts through the end of your next turn.

source:
你触碰一个自愿生物，并使目标在法术持续时间内移动时不受困难地形限制，并且任何法术或其他魔法效应都不能降低目标的速度，或者使目标陷入麻痹或束缚状态。目标还会获得等同于其速度的游泳速度。
此外，该目标还可以花费5尺移动力直接从非魔法的束缚物中挣脱（诸如镣铐或其他生物对其施加的受擒状态）。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，你就可以额外再指定一名生物作为此法术的目标。
target:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, its movement is unaffected by Difficult Terrain, and spells and other magical effects cannot reduce its Speed or give it the Paralyzed or Restrained condition. The target also gains a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.
The target can also spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or the Grappled condition imposed by another creature.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; nonmagical escape costs movement, and the Swim Speed and extra-target scaling are retained.

source:
你召唤一只巨化的蜈蚣、蜘蛛或黄蜂（你施法时选择）。其使用下文巨虫Giant Insect的数据，并会在施法距离内一处你可见的未被占据的空间中显现。你选择的形态决定了其数据中的部分细节。该生物会在生命值降为0或是法术结束时消失。
该生物是你和你盟友的盟友。它在战斗中使用你的先攻，并在你回合结束后立即执行其回合。它遵从于你的口头指令（无需任何动作）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作并使用其移动力以远离危险。
升环施法：在生物数据中使用更高的法术环阶。

巨虫Giant Insect
大型野兽，无阵营
AC 11+法术环阶
HP 30+每比四环高一环阶10点
速度 40尺，攀爬40尺，飞行40尺（仅限黄蜂）
力量17|+3|+3 敏捷13|+1|+1 体质15|+2|+2
智力4|-3|-3 感知14|+2|+2 魅力3|-4|-4
感官：黑暗视觉60尺，被动察觉12
语言：理解你所知晓的语言
CR 无（XP0；PB等同于你的熟练加值）
特质Traits
蛛行Spider Climb。 巨虫能够在困难表面上攀爬，包括在天花板上攀爬，而不需要进行属性检定。
动作Actions
多重攻击Multiattack。巨虫发动等同于法术环数一半次数的攻击（向下取整）。
猛毒刺Poison Jab。近战攻击检定：加值等同于你的法术攻击调整值，触及10尺。命中：1d6+3+法术环阶点穿刺伤害+1d4点毒素伤害。
蛛网箭Web Bolt（仅限蜘蛛）。远程攻击检定：加值等同于你的法术攻击调整值，射程60尺。命中：1d10+3+法术环阶点钝击伤害，且目标的速度降为0直至巨虫的下个回合开始。
附赠动作Bonus Actions
剧毒喷涌Venomous Spew（仅限蜈蚣）。体质豁免：DC等同于你的法术豁免DC，一名距巨虫10尺内且巨虫可见的生物。失败：目标陷入中毒状态直至巨虫的下个回合开始。
target:
You summon a giant centipede, spider, or wasp, chosen when you cast the spell. It uses the Giant Insect stat block below and appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. Your chosen form determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends.
The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands, which require no action. If you give no commands, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Use the higher spell level in the creature's stat block.

Giant Insect
Large Beast, Unaligned
AC 11 + the spell's level
HP 30 + 10 for each spell level above 4
Speed 40 ft., Climb 40 ft., Fly 40 ft. (Wasp Only)
STR 17 | +3 | +3; DEX 13 | +1 | +1; CON 15 | +2 | +2
INT 4 | -3 | -3; WIS 14 | +2 | +2; CHA 3 | -4 | -4
Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 12
Languages: Understands the languages you know
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Traits
Spider Climb. The insect can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without making an ability check.
Actions
Multiattack. The insect makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell's level, rounded down.
Poison Jab. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 10 ft. Hit: 1d6 + 3 + the spell's level Piercing damage plus 1d4 Poison damage.
Web Bolt (Spider Only). Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 60 ft. Hit: 1d10 + 3 + the spell's level Bludgeoning damage, and the target's Speed becomes 0 until the start of the insect's next turn.
Bonus Actions
Venomous Spew (Centipede Only). Constitution Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, one creature within 10 feet of the insect that it can see. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the insect's next turn.
note: Complete summoning rules and stat block translated, including all six three-value ability rows, form restrictions, hit effects, and the centipede bonus action. No unstated restriction on Spider Climb is added.

source:
你指定施法距离内一个你能够看见的未被占据的空间，并召唤一条藤蔓使其从该空间的地面上破土而出。藤蔓直到法术结束为止会一直存在。
对一名距藤蔓30尺内的生物进行一次近战法术攻击。命中时，目标受到4d8点钝击伤害并被往藤蔓所在方向拉近30尺。如果目标体型不超过巨型，则目标同时陷入受擒状态（逃脱DC等同于你的法术豁免DC）。藤蔓在同一时间只能擒抱一名生物，但你随时可以让藤蔓放开一名受擒的生物（无需动作）。
直至该法术终止前，你可以在你随后的回合里用一个附赠动作再次对一名距其30尺内的生物进行这样的攻击。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，藤蔓便可额外擒抱一名生物。
target:
Choose an unoccupied space you can see within range. You summon a vine that sprouts from the ground there and remains until the spell ends.
Make a melee spell attack against one creature within 30 feet of the vine. On a hit, the target takes 4d8 Bludgeoning damage and is pulled 30 feet toward the vine. If the target is Huge or smaller, it also has the Grappled condition, with an escape DC equal to your spell save DC. The vine can grapple only one creature at a time, but you can make it release a Grappled creature at any time without taking an action.
Until the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on each of your subsequent turns to make this attack again against one creature within 30 feet of the vine.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The vine can grapple one additional creature for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; pulling, damage, and size-limited grappling remain on a hit, and higher slots increase grapple capacity rather than the number of attacks.

source:
一名大型灵体守护者出现在施法距离内一处由你指定的，你可见且未被占据的空间，并在法术持续时间内在该处悬浮。占据该空间的守护者是无敌的，并且会以适合你神祇或神系的形态出现。
任何敌人在一回合内首次进入距守护者10尺内或于其10尺内开始其回合时，必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败受到20点光耀伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。守护者在造成总计60点伤害后随即消失。
target:
A Large spectral guardian appears in an unoccupied space you choose that you can see within range and hovers there for the duration. The guardian occupies that space, is invulnerable, and appears in a form appropriate to your deity or pantheon.
Any enemy that enters a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn or starts its turn within 10 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The guardian disappears after dealing a total of 60 damage.
note: Full passage translated; the source includes a start-of-turn trigger, and the cumulative 60-damage disappearance condition is preserved.

source:
你使施法距离内一处150尺立方区域内的自然地形在视觉、听觉、嗅觉上都像是另一种自然地形。因此，开阔的平原或者道路可能会变得像是一片沼泽，或是丘陵、裂谷以及其他难以通过，甚至是无法通过的地形。一个池塘可能变得看起来像一片草地，一个悬崖像是一个缓坡，或者使一条乱石沟像是一条宽阔平坦的道路。区域内经过加工的建筑、装备或生物的外表不会改变。
地形的触觉特征不会改变，所以进入这片区域的生物可能会看穿幻象。如果触觉区别不明显，一个仔细调查幻象的生物可以采取研究动作，尝试进行一次对抗法术豁免 DC 的智力（调查）检定以识破之。对于一个识破了幻象本体的生物，幻象看起来就像是一层模糊的图像叠加在真实地形上。
target:
You make the natural terrain in a 150-foot Cube within range look, sound, and smell like another kind of natural terrain. Open plains or a road might appear to be a swamp, hills, a chasm, or other difficult or even impassable terrain. A pond might look like a grassy meadow, a cliff like a gentle slope, or a rocky ravine like a broad, smooth road. The appearance of manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures in the area does not change.
The terrain's tactile qualities do not change, so creatures entering the area might see through the illusion. If the difference in texture is not obvious, a creature carefully examining the illusion can take the Study action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern it. To a creature that recognizes the illusion for what it is, it appears as a vague image superimposed on the real terrain.
note: Full passage translated, including every terrain example, unchanged tactile properties, and the Study action and check.

source:
以施法距离内一点为中心的一处半径20尺，高40尺的柱状区域内，岩石般坚硬的冰雹重重地砸向地面。每个处在范围内的生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将受到2d10点钝击伤害和 4d6 点冷冻伤害，豁免成功则受到一半伤害。
冰雹使柱状区域内的地面变为困难地形，直至你的下一回合结束。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比四环高一环，此法术的钝击伤害就增加1d10。
target:
Rock-hard hail pounds the ground in a Cylinder with a 20-foot radius and a height of 40 feet, centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Bludgeoning damage and 4d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The hail makes the ground in the Cylinder Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; only the Bludgeoning component scales with slot level, and Difficult Terrain ends at the end of your next turn.

source:
你将一个箱子及其内容物藏在以太位面。你必须同时接触箱子和作为法术材料成分的微缩模型。箱子最多可容纳12立方尺的非活体物质（3×2×2 尺）。
箱子处于以太位面时，你可以用一个魔法动作并触碰箱子的模型来召回箱子。箱子出现在你 5 尺内一个未被占据空间的地面。随后，你可以使用一个魔法动作并同时触碰箱子与微缩模型来把箱子送回以太位面。
60日之后，法术的效应会每日累计5%的概率自动结束。如果你再次施展该法术或箱子的模型被摧毁，该法术的效应也将随之终止。如果法术终止时箱子处于以太界，则其留在那里等待被你或者其他人找到。
target:
You hide a chest and its contents on the Ethereal Plane. You must simultaneously touch both the chest and the miniature replica that serves as the spell's Material component. The chest can hold up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving matter, measuring 3 by 2 by 2 feet.
While the chest is on the Ethereal Plane, you can take a Magic action and touch the replica to recall it. The chest appears on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. You can then take a Magic action and simultaneously touch both the chest and the replica to return the chest to the Ethereal Plane.
After 60 days, there is a cumulative 5 percent chance each day that the spell's effect ends on its own. The effect also ends if you cast the spell again or the replica is destroyed. If the spell ends while the chest is in the Ethereal realm, it remains there until you or someone else finds it.
note: Full passage translated; the final source wording says Ethereal realm rather than changing to another plane. Both Magic actions, dimensions, and the cumulative daily chance are preserved.

source:
你点名或描述一个你熟悉的生物。只要该生物与你相距不超过1000尺，你就会感测到该生物的方位。如果该生物正在移动，则你也将知晓其移动的方向。
该法术可以定位一个你认识的特定生物；或者它也可以定位特定的一类生物（例如人类或独角兽）中距你最近的个体，不过你需要曾经在 30 尺的近距离内看到过该类生物至少一次。如果被点名或描述的生物并不处于其原本的形态（例如正被一个变形术Polymorph或石化术Flesh to Stone的法术效应影响），则该法术无法定位该生物。
如果有任意厚度的铅，即使只是薄薄一片铅片阻挡了你与被定位物件间的通路，则该生物也无法被该法术所定位。
target:
Name or describe a creature familiar to you. You sense the direction to it as long as it is no more than 1,000 feet from you. If it is moving, you also know the direction of its movement.
The spell can locate a specific creature you know or the nearest creature of a particular kind, such as a human or unicorn, provided you have seen that kind of creature at least once from within 30 feet. If the named or described creature is not in its original form, such as when affected by Polymorph or Flesh to Stone, the spell cannot locate it.
Lead of any thickness, even a thin sheet, blocking the path between you and the target prevents the spell from locating the creature.
note: Full passage translated. The final source sentence calls the located target an object inside a creature-locating rule; neutral "target" retains the intended reference without inventing an object-targeting option.

source:
指定施法距离内一处你能看见且未被占据的空间，你在该处创造出一只幻影守护犬。守护犬持续存在至法术结束或你们之间的距离超过300 尺。
只有你能看见守护犬，它无法被触及且不会受伤。当一个体型不小于小型的生物进入守护犬 30 尺内时，如果该生物无法说出你在施法时设定的口令，守护犬则会开始大声吠叫。守护犬拥有30尺真实视觉。
在你的每回合开始时，守护犬会尝试啮咬其5尺范围内的一个敌人。该生物进行一次敏捷豁免，失败则受到4d8点力场伤害。
在你施展法术的后续回合里，你能够以一个魔法动作令守护犬移动至多30尺。
target:
Choose an unoccupied space you can see within range. You create a phantom watchdog there, which remains until the spell ends or you are more than 300 feet apart.
Only you can see the hound. It cannot be touched or harmed. When a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet of it without speaking the password you set when casting the spell, the hound begins barking loudly. It has Truesight out to 30 feet.
At the start of each of your turns, the hound tries to bite one enemy within 5 feet of it. That creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 Force damage on a failed save.
On turns after you cast the spell, you can take a Magic action to move the hound up to 30 feet.
note: Full passage translated; the source explicitly uses a distance greater than 300 feet, and no damage on a successful save is added.

source:
你对施法距离内一片区域施以魔法防护。该区域为一立方区域，其边长至小5尺，大至 100 尺。该法术持续至持续时间结束。
施展该法术时，其提供的防护效应由你决定。从下列词条中选择一种或多种生效：
　　• 声音不能穿透被保护区域边缘的障壁
　　• 被保护区域的障壁变得黑暗而模糊，无法通过视觉（包括黑暗视觉）看穿。
　　• 预言法术创造的传感器无法出现在被保护区域内，也无法穿过区域边界处的障壁。
　　• 区域内的生物不能成为预言法术的目标。
　　• 任何事物无法通过传送进出被保护区域。
　　• 在被保护区域内，位面旅行被封锁。
当你每日在同一个位置施展此法术，持续365日后，法术将成为永久效应（直到被解除）。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，此法术立方区域的边长就可以增加100尺。
target:
You magically ward an area within range. The area is a Cube from 5 feet to 100 feet on a side. The spell lasts for its duration.
When you cast the spell, choose one or more of the following protections:
• Sound cannot pass through the barrier at the edge of the warded area.
• The barrier around the warded area becomes dark and foggy, blocking vision, including Darkvision.
• Sensors created by Divination spells cannot appear inside the warded area or pass through the barrier at its perimeter.
• Creatures in the area cannot be targeted by Divination spells.
• Nothing can teleport into or out of the warded area.
• Planar travel is blocked within the warded area.
Casting this spell at the same location every day for 365 days makes its effects permanent until dispelled.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The Cube's maximum side length increases by 100 feet for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; all six independently selectable protections and the 365-day permanence condition were checked.

source:
一颗微微发光的法球将施法距离内一个大型或更小的生物或物件封在其中。非自愿的生物必须成功通过一次敏捷豁免，否则在法术持续时间内被封在球体中。
任何事物，包括实体物件、能量或其它法术效应，都不能穿透障壁进出其内，不过生物在球内仍可以正常呼吸。球体免疫一切伤害，且球内的生物或物件不能被来自球外的攻击或效应所伤害，球内的生物也不能对球外的任何事物造成伤害。
该球体没有重量，而其尺寸恰好可以容纳球内的生物或物件。被封住的生物可以使用一个动作推动球壁并以至多该生物速度一半的速度滚动球体。另外，球体也可以被其他生物拿起或移动。
以球体为目标施展一道解离术Disintegrate可以摧毁球体而不伤害球内的任何事物。
target:
A shimmering sphere encloses one Large or smaller creature or object within range. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be enclosed in the sphere for the duration.
Nothing, including physical objects, energy, or other spell effects, can pass into or out of the barrier, though a creature inside can breathe normally. The sphere is immune to all damage. A creature or object inside cannot be harmed by attacks or effects from outside, and a creature inside cannot damage anything outside.
The sphere is weightless and just large enough to contain the enclosed creature or object. An enclosed creature can take an action to push against the sphere's walls, rolling the sphere at up to half the creature's Speed. Other creatures can also pick up or move the sphere.
A Disintegrate spell targeting the sphere destroys it without harming anything inside.
note: Full passage translated; the Disintegrate exception destroys the sphere without harming its contents. Movement is limited to half Speed, with an action required.

source:
你指定施法距离内一名你可见的生物，窥探其噩梦，依此创造一道只有目标能看见的幻象。目标生物进行一次感知豁免。豁免失败时，目标受到4d10点心灵伤害，且在法术持续时间内进行的所有属性检定与攻击检定都具有劣势。豁免成功，则目标只受一半伤害，法术终止。
法术持续时间内，目标在其每回合结束时进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败将再次受到心灵伤害。豁免成功则法术终止。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d10。
target:
Choose one creature you can see within range. You probe its nightmares and create an illusion based on them that only the target can see. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 4d10 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on all ability checks and attack rolls for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage, and the spell ends.
For the duration, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failed save, it takes the Psychic damage again. On a successful save, the spell ends.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; the initial successful save deals half damage, whereas a later successful save only ends the spell as written.

source:
你尝试将施法距离内你可见的一名生物转变为一只野兽。目标必须成功于一次感知豁免，否则在持续时间内被变形为野兽形态。这种野兽形态可以是你所选的挑战等级不大于目标（若目标没有挑战等级，则使用目标的等级）的任意野兽。目标的游戏数据被替换为所选野兽的数据，但目标保留其阵营、性格、生物类型、生命值、生命值骰。野兽的具体数据见附录B。
目标获得等同于其野兽形态生命值的临时生命值。若目标没有剩余的临时生命值，则法术提前终止。
该生物只可做出其新形态的生理结构所允许的动作。它不能说话也不能施法。
目标的装备融入新形态中。目标不能使用装备或者通过其他方式从装备中获得增益。
target:
You attempt to transform one creature you can see within range into a Beast. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into Beast form for the duration. You can choose any Beast whose Challenge Rating does not exceed the target's Challenge Rating, or its level if it has no Challenge Rating. The target's game statistics are replaced by those of the chosen Beast, but it retains its alignment, personality, creature type, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice. See Appendix B for Beast statistics.
The target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of its Beast form. The spell ends early if the target has no Temporary Hit Points remaining.
The creature can take only actions physically possible for its new form. It cannot speak or cast spells.
The target's equipment melds into its new form. It cannot use its equipment or otherwise benefit from it.
note: Full passage translated; retained creature type, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice follow this source. The early-end sentence refers to remaining Temporary Hit Points without specifying their source, so that qualification is not added.

source:
被该次攻击检定命中的目标会在此次攻击中额外受到4d6点心灵伤害。该目标必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则目标陷入震慑状态直到你的下个回合结束。
升环施法：使用高于四环的法术位施放本法术时，你使用的法术位每比四环高一环，额外伤害就增加1d6。
target:
The target hit by the triggering attack roll takes an extra 4d6 Psychic damage from that attack. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, having the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn on a failed save.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell with a slot above level 4, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; only the Stunned condition depends on the saving throw, while the extra damage belongs to the triggering hit.

source: 你触碰一个体积为中型或更小的石质物件或某块岩石在任何方向都不超过 5 尺的一部分，并将其塑造成你想要的任意形状。例如你可以将一块大石头塑造成一件武器、一尊塑像、或一个保险箱，也可以在石墙上开出一条小通道，前提是墙的厚度不能超过 5 尺。你也可以使一扇石门或石质门框变形来将门封死。你创造的物件最多可以有两条铰链和一道闩，除此之外不能以该法术塑造出更复杂的机械结构。
target: You touch a Medium or smaller stone object or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and shape it into any form you wish. For example, you can shape a large rock into a weapon, a statue, or a coffer, or make a small passage through a stone wall, provided the wall is no more than 5 feet thick. You can also reshape a stone door or doorframe to seal the door shut. An object you create can have up to two hinges and a latch, but the spell cannot create more intricate mechanisms.
note: Full passage translated; both size limits, all examples, and the two-hinge and one-latch mechanism limit are retained.

source:
你唤来一个异怪灵魄。其使用下文异怪灵魄的数据，并会在施法距离内一处你可见的未被占据的空间中显现。当你施展法术时，从类眼魔，夺心魔和史拉蟾中选择一个类别。该生物会显化为你所选的那一类异怪，其数据中的部分特性也受此影响。该生物会在生命值降为0或是法术结束时消失。
该生物是你的盟友（对你的其它盟友亦是如此）。它在战斗中使用你的先攻，并在你回合结束后立即行动。它遵从于你的口头指令（无需任何动作）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作并远离危险。
升环施法：该生物的数据使用新的法术环阶。

异怪灵魄Aberrant Spirit
中型异怪，绝对中立
AC 11+法术环阶
HP 40+每比4环高的法术环阶10点
速度30 尺；飞行30尺（悬浮；仅类眼魔）
力量16|+3|+3 敏捷10|+0|+0 体质15|+2|+2
智力16|+3|+3 感知10|+0|+0 魅力6|-2|-2
免疫：心灵
感官：黑暗视觉60尺，被动察觉10
语言：深潜语，理解你的语言
CR无（XP0；PB等于你的熟练加值）
特质Traits
再生Regeneration（仅史拉蟾）。灵魄在其回合开始时恢复5点生命值，前提是它至少有1点生命值。
低语灵光Whispering Aura（仅夺心魔）。只要灵魄并未失能，它就会在自己的每个回合开始时释放出灵能能量。感知豁免：DC等于你的法术豁免DC，灵魄5尺内的每个生物（除你之外）。失败：2d6心灵伤害
动作Actions
多重攻击Multiattack。灵魄发动等于法术环阶一半次数的攻击（向下取整）。
爪击Claw（仅史拉蟾）。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：1d10+3+法术环阶的挥砍伤害，目标无法恢复生命值直至灵魄的下一回合开始。
眼波射线Eye Ray（仅类眼魔）。远程攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，射程150尺。命中：1d8+3+法术环阶的心灵伤害。
灵能猛击Psychic Slam（仅夺心魔）。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：1d8+3+法术环阶的心灵伤害。
target:
You call forth an aberrant spirit. It uses the Aberrant Spirit stat block below and appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast the spell, choose Beholderkin, Mind Flayer, or Slaad. The creature manifests as an aberration of that kind, which determines certain traits in its stat block. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends.
The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative and acts immediately after your turn. It obeys your verbal commands, which require no action. If you give no commands, it takes the Dodge action and moves away from danger.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Use the new spell level in the creature's stat block.

Aberrant Spirit
Medium Aberration, Neutral
AC 11 + the spell's level
HP 40 + 10 for each spell level above 4
Speed 30 ft.; Fly 30 ft. (Hover; Beholderkin Only)
STR 16 | +3 | +3; DEX 10 | +0 | +0; CON 15 | +2 | +2
INT 16 | +3 | +3; WIS 10 | +0 | +0; CHA 6 | -2 | -2
Immunities: Psychic damage
Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10
Languages: Deep Speech, understands your languages
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Traits
Regeneration (Slaad Only). The spirit regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point.
Whispering Aura (Mind Flayer Only). As long as the spirit is not Incapacitated, it releases psychic energy at the start of each of its turns. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, each creature within 5 feet of the spirit other than you. Failure: 2d6 Psychic damage.
Actions
Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell's level, rounded down.
Claw (Slaad Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack bonus, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d10 + 3 + the spell's level Slashing damage, and the target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of the spirit's next turn.
Eye Ray (Beholderkin Only). Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack bonus, range 150 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level Psychic damage.
Psychic Slam (Mind Flayer Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack bonus, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level Psychic damage.
note: Complete summoning rules and stat block translated; all six three-value ability rows, each form restriction, the aura exception for the caster, and regeneration at 1 or more Hit Points are preserved.

你唤来一个构装灵魄。其使用下文构装灵魄的数据，并会在施法距离内一处你可见的未被占据的空间中显现。当你施展法术时，从粘土、金属、岩石中选择一种材料，该生物会显现为以该种材料制成的活化雕像（由你决定其外观），其数据中的部分特性也受此影响。该生物会在生命值降为0或是法术结束时消失。
该生物是你的盟友（对你的其它盟友亦是如此）。它在战斗中使用你的先攻，并在你回合结束后立即行动。它遵从于你的口头指令（无需任何动作）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作并远离危险。
升环施法：该生物的数据使用新的法术环阶。

构装灵魄Construct Spirit 
中型构装，绝对中立
AC 13+法术环阶
HP 40+每比4环高的法术环阶15点
速度30尺
力量18|+4|+4 敏捷10|+0|+0 体质18|+4|+4
智力14|+2|+2 感知11|+0|+0 魅力5|-3|-3
抗性：毒素
免疫：魅惑，力竭，恐慌，麻痹，中毒
感官：黑暗视觉60尺，被动察觉10
语言：理解你的语言
CR无（XP0；PB等于你的熟练加值）
特质Traits
灼热之躯Heated Body（仅金属）。当一个生物对灵魄发动近战攻击并命中，或是在擒抱灵魄、被灵魄擒抱期间开始其回合时，那个生物受到1d10火焰伤害。
石迷昏眠Stony Lethargy（仅岩石）。当一个灵魄可见的生物在其10 尺距离内开始回合时，它可以对其释放出一道魔法能量。感知豁免：DC等于你的法术豁免DC，被指定的生物。失败：目标不能进行借机攻击且速度减半，持续直至其下一回合开始。
动作Actions
多重攻击Multiattack。灵魄发动等于法术环阶一半次数的猛击攻击（向下取整）。
猛击Slam。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：1d8+4+法术环阶的钝击伤害。
反应Reactions
狂怒乱击Berserk Lashing（仅粘土）。触发：一个生物对灵魄造成了伤害。响应：灵魄对该目标发动一次猛击攻击（若可能），或者灵魄向那个目标移动至多等于其速度一半的距离且不引发借机攻击。
target:
You call forth a construct spirit. It uses the Construct Spirit stat block below and appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast the spell, choose Clay, Metal, or Stone. The creature appears as an animated statue made of that material, with an appearance you choose; the material also determines certain traits in its stat block. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends.
The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative and acts immediately after your turn. It obeys your verbal commands, which require no action. If you give no commands, it takes the Dodge action and moves away from danger.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Use the new spell level in the creature's stat block.

Construct Spirit
Medium Construct, Neutral
AC 13 + the spell's level
HP 40 + 15 for each spell level above 4
Speed 30 ft.
STR 18 | +4 | +4; DEX 10 | +0 | +0; CON 18 | +4 | +4
INT 14 | +2 | +2; WIS 11 | +0 | +0; CHA 5 | -3 | -3
Resistances: Poison damage
Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10
Languages: Understands your languages
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Traits
Heated Body (Metal Only). A creature takes 1d10 Fire damage when it hits the spirit with a melee attack or starts its turn while grappling the spirit or being grappled by it.
Stony Lethargy (Stone Only). When a creature the spirit can see starts its turn within 10 feet of the spirit, the spirit can release magical energy at it. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, the targeted creature. Failure: The target cannot make Opportunity Attacks, and its Speed is halved until the start of its next turn.
Actions
Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of Slam attacks equal to half the spell's level, rounded down.
Slam. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack bonus, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 4 + the spell's level Bludgeoning damage.
Reactions
Berserk Lashing (Clay Only). Trigger: A creature damages the spirit. Response: The spirit makes one Slam attack against that target if possible, or moves toward that target up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
note: Complete summoning rules and stat block translated; all six three-value ability rows and damage-versus-condition defenses are kept. The stone failure effects end at the target's next turn, and the clay response retains the attack-or-move alternative.

你唤来一个元素灵魄。其使用下文元素灵魄的数据，并会在施法距离内一处你可见的未被占据的空间中显现。当你施展法术时，从气、土、火、水中选择一种元素，该生物会显现为由你所选元素组成的二足模糊人影，其数据中的部分特性也受此影响。该生物会在生命值降为0或是法术结束时消失。
该生物是你的盟友（对你的其它盟友亦是如此）。它在战斗中使用你的先攻，并在你回合结束后立即行动。它遵从于你的口头指令（无需任何动作）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作并远离危险。
升环施法：该生物的数据使用新的法术环阶。

元素灵魄Elemental Spirit 
中型元素，绝对中立
AC 11+法术环阶
HP 50+每比4环高的法术环阶10点
速度40尺；掘穴40尺（仅土）；飞行40尺（悬浮；仅气）；游泳40尺（仅水）
力量18|+4|+4 敏捷15|+2|+2 体质17|+3|+3
智力4|-3|-3 感知10|+0|+0 魅16|+3|+3

语言：原初语，理解你的语言
CR无（XP0；PB等于你的熟练加值）
特质Traits
不定形态Amorphous Form（仅气、火、水）。灵魄能够轻松穿过最窄1寸宽的狭窄空间，如同其是困难地形一般。
动作Actions
多重攻击Multiattack。灵魄发动等于法术环阶一半次数的猛击攻击（向下取整）。
猛击Slam。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：1d10+4+法术环阶的钝击（仅土）、冷冻（仅水）、闪电（仅气）、火焰（仅火）伤害。
target:
You call forth an elemental spirit. It uses the Elemental Spirit stat block below and appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast the spell, choose Air, Earth, Fire, or Water. The creature appears as a vaguely humanoid, two-legged shape made of that element, which determines certain traits in its stat block. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Use the new spell level in the creature's stat block.

Elemental Spirit
Medium Elemental, Neutral
AC 11 + the spell's level
HP 50 + 10 for each spell level above 4
Speed 40 ft.; Burrow 40 ft. (Earth Only); Fly 40 ft. (Hover; Air Only); Swim 40 ft. (Water Only)
STR 18 | +4 | +4; DEX 15 | +2 | +2; CON 17 | +3 | +3
INT 4 | -3 | -3; WIS 10 | +0 | +0; CHA 16 | +3 | +3
Resistances: Acid (Water Only), Lightning and Thunder (Air Only), Piercing and Slashing (Earth Only)
Immunities: Fire (Fire Only), Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

Languages: Primordial, understands your languages

Amorphous Form (Air, Fire, and Water Only). The spirit can pass through a space as narrow as 1 cun wide as if it were Difficult Terrain.

Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of Slam attacks equal to half the spell's level, rounded down.

你指向施法距离内一点，一颗发光的直径1尺的酸液球飞向那个位置，随后爆炸，波及20尺半径球状区域。在该区域中的每名生物进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败的生物不仅将受到10d4点强酸伤害，其下个回合结束时还将再受到5d4点强酸伤害。若豁免成功，该生物只受到初始伤害的一半伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，此法术的初始伤害便增加2d4。
target:
You point to a spot within range. A glowing ball of acid, 1 foot in diameter, flies there and explodes in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d4 Acid damage and takes another 5d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes only half the initial damage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The initial damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; delayed damage is only on a failed save, and higher slots increase only the initial damage.

你在施法距离内一块固体表面上创造出一面火墙。你可以选择创造长不过 60 尺、高不过 20 尺、厚不过 1 尺的直线型火墙；或是直径不过 20 尺、高不过 20 尺、厚不过 1 尺的环形火墙。火墙不透明，且将持续存在至法术终止。
火墙出现时，所有位于火墙所占据的区域内的生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败，受到 5d8 点火焰伤害。豁免成功，则只受一半伤害。
施展该法术时，你选择火墙的哪一侧会造成伤害。生物在火墙造成伤害一侧10尺内或火墙所占据的区域内结束其回合时将受到5d8点火焰伤害。在一个回合内首次进入火墙或在火墙所占据的区域内结束自己的回合时也会受到同样的伤害。火墙的另一侧不会造成伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比四环高一环，此法术造成的伤害就提高1d8。
target:
You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make a straight wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts until the spell ends.
When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
When you cast the spell, choose which side of the wall deals damage. A creature takes 5d8 Fire damage if it ends its turn within 10 feet of that side or in the wall's area. A creature also takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn in the wall's area. The other side of the wall deals no damage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated. The source repeats the end-of-turn-in-the-wall trigger in two sentences; that repetition is retained, without inventing an additional stacking rule.

• 指定施法距离内至多一个你能看见的生物，选择下述伤害类型之一：强酸，冷冻，火焰，闪电或雷鸣，并迫使目标进行一次体质豁免检定。豁免失败者直至法术终止前，每回合第一次受到选定类型的伤害时，目标额外受到2d6点对应类型的伤害。此外，直到法术终止，该目标失去对该伤害类型的任何抗性。
• 升环施法效应：使用5环或更高法术位施放该法术时，你使用的法术位每比4环高一环，就能多指定一个目标。而各目标之间距离不能超过30尺。
context: column:M;spell:Elemental Bane;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:4
target:
• Choose up to one creature you can see within range and one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the following effects apply until the spell ends: the target loses any resistance to the chosen damage type, and the first time each turn that it takes damage of that type, it takes an extra 2d6 damage of that type.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 or higher spell slot, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4. The targets must be within 30 feet of one another.
note: Retains the once-per-turn first-damage trigger and loss of resistance; no immunity removal is added. This 2024 workbook passage and its complete context exactly match the previously reviewed source text; its English translation is reused without replacing any different-version rule. Second reading tightened the reused English sentence so both extra damage and loss of resistance explicitly remain in the failed-save branch; source mechanics are unchanged. Phase 18 root clarification: both effects share the failed-save duration, while only extra damage has the first-damage-each-turn restriction. This exact wording was also applied to the previously reviewed identical 2014 source.

• 你召唤一个圣魂并呈现出忠诚的、雄伟的坐骑外观。坐骑显现在施法距离内未被占据的空间，其外形由你从以下形态中选择：狮鹫Griffon、飞马Pegasus、鹿鹰兽Peryton、恐狼Dire Wolf、犀牛Rhinoceros或者剑齿虎Saber-toothed Tiger（DM也可以允许你选择其他动物作坐骑）。坐骑拥有你所选形态的属性数据，但他实际上属于天界生物，精类生物或邪魔的一种（由你选择）而不是通常类型。另外，如果你的坐骑智力为5或更低，则其智力变为6，同时能听懂一门你掌握的语言。
• 不管是否在战斗中，坐骑都能为你提供帮助，而你们之间的契约让你们行动更为紧密。你乘上该坐骑时，所有你施展的只以自身为目标的法术同时也影响该坐骑。
• 该坐骑生命值降至0时消失不见，且不留下任何物质残余。你也可以随时用一个动作解散该坐骑使其消失。此后，每当你重新施展该法术时，将满生命值的召唤同一匹坐骑显现。
• 坐骑在你身边1里内时，你可以与其以心灵感应的方式进行交流。
• 你不能用该法术同时拥有一匹以上的坐骑，你可以随时用一个动作将坐骑从契约中解放，并使其消失不见。
context: column:M;spell:Find Greater Steed;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:4
target:
• You summon a holy spirit that takes the form of a loyal, magnificent mount. It appears in an unoccupied space within range in one of the following forms of your choice: Griffon, Pegasus, Peryton, Dire Wolf, Rhinoceros, or Saber-toothed Tiger. The DM may also allow another animal as a mount. The mount uses the statistics of the chosen form, but its type is Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice) instead of its usual type. In addition, if its Intelligence is 5 or lower, its Intelligence becomes 6, and it understands one language you speak.
• The mount assists you both in and out of combat, and your bond lets you act in close coordination. While you are mounted on it, every spell you cast that targets only yourself also affects the mount.
• When the mount drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving no physical remains. You can also dismiss it at any time as an action, causing it to disappear. Each subsequent time you cast this spell, you summon the same mount at full hit points.
• While the mount is within 1 li of you, you can communicate with it telepathically.
• You cannot have more than one mount from this spell at a time. You can release the mount from its bond at any time as an action, causing it to disappear.
note: The source uses bare li for the telepathic distance, not an explicit mile; retained as li pending unit review. The source's holy-spirit description and self-targeted spell sharing are retained without adding restrictions from another version. This 2024 workbook passage and its complete context exactly match the previously reviewed source text; its English translation is reused without replacing any different-version rule.

• 自然之魂回应你的呼唤并将你转变为一个强大的守卫。转变持续到法术结束。你选择以下形态之一取得：原始猛兽或战争巨树。
• 原始猛兽Primal Beast：如野兽般的皮毛覆盖你的身体，你的面部特征变得野性，并且你得到以下增益：
  你的步行速度增加10尺。
  你得到120尺的黑暗视觉。
  你基于力量的攻击检定具有优势。
  你的近战武器攻击在击中时会造成额外1d6力场伤害。
• 战争巨树Great Tree：你的皮肤出现树纹，枝叶从你的头发上萌芽，并且你得到以下增益：
  你得到10点临时生命值。
  你的体质豁免检定具有优势。
  你基于敏捷或基于感知的攻击检定具有优势。
  当你在地面上时，你周围15尺的地面对于你的敌人而言是困难地形。
context: column:M;spell:Guardian of Nature;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:4
target:

On a successful save, you lose control of it for the rest of the spell's duration, and it spends its turns pursuing and attacking the nearest nondemons to the best of its ability. Even if you stop concentrating on the spell before its full duration elapses, an uncontrolled demon does not disappear for 1d6 rounds as long as it still has hit points.
• As part of casting this spell, you can use the blood serving as its material component to draw a magic circle on the ground, large enough to include your space. For the duration, the summoned demon cannot cross or harm the circle or target anyone inside it. Material components used in this way are consumed when the spell ends.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 or higher spell slot, the maximum challenge rating of the demon you can summon increases by +1 for each slot level above 4.
note: The source's no-command behavior specifically describes attacking creatures within reach that attack the demon; this is retained rather than replaced with a different published wording. The uncontrolled persistence and blood-circle consumption are fully retained. • You conjure a sphere of water with a 5-foot radius at a point you can see within range. The sphere can hover in the air, but no more than 10 feet above the ground. It remains for the duration.
• Any creature in the sphere's space must make a Strength saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is ejected into the nearest unoccupied space around the sphere. All creatures restrained by the sphere move with it. You can ram the sphere into creatures to force them to make the saving throw.
• When the spell ends, the sphere falls to the ground, extinguishing all ordinary flames within 30 feet of it. Any creatures restrained by it fall prone where it lands. The water then disappears.

source: 你咒唤一团能够伤害超自然生物的细密尘云。以施法距离内一点为中心，你创造一片半径30尺的球状尘霭。选择一种除野兽或类人外的生物类型。区域内所有属于所选类型的生物受到20力场伤害。当尘霭移动到某个生物所在的空间时，或当生物进入该球状区域、或是在该区域内结束其回合时，该生物同样受到此伤害。一个生物每回合仅会受到一次此伤害。
context: column:M;spell:Dust of Suleiman;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:4
target: You conjure a fine cloud of dust that harms supernatural creatures. You create a 30-foot-radius Sphere of dust centered on a point within range. Choose a creature type other than Beast or Humanoid. All creatures of the chosen type in the area take 20 Force damage. source: 你咒唤出犹格·索托斯的恐怖卷须重击你的敌人。你选择施法距离内一个生物，迫使其进行一次力量豁免。豁免失败者受到8d6暗蚀伤害，陷入倒地状态，且你可以在施法范围内将其往任意方向移动至多40尺。豁免成功则仅受8d6暗蚀伤害。
context: column:M;spell:Fist of Yog-Sothoth;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:4
target: You conjure the horrific tendrils of Yog-Sothoth to batter your foe. Choose one creature within range and force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 8d6 Necrotic damage, has the Prone condition, and you can move it up to 40 feet in any direction within the spell's range. On a successful save, it takes only the 8d6 Necrotic damage.
note: Full passage translated; the source explicitly gives the full 8d6 damage on a successful save, not half. Prone and optional movement remain confined to failure.

你以一种以恶性寄生虫为形式的魔法疾病感染施法范围内你能看到的一个生物。每回合一次，当一个生物以武器攻击命中被感染的目标时，该次攻击额外造成4d6点黯蚀伤害，并且攻击者恢复与造成的黯蚀伤害数值等同的生命值。每当被感染的生物受到这样的黯蚀伤害时，它可以进行一次对抗本法术的体质豁免。若豁免检定成功，则法术终止。
升环施法效应：使用五环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比四环高一环，黯蚀伤害就增加1d6点。
target:
You infect one creature you can see within range with a magical disease in the form of a malignant parasite. Once per turn, when a creature hits the infected target with a weapon attack, that attack deals an extra 4d6 Necrotic damage, and the attacker regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. Whenever the infected creature takes this Necrotic damage, it can make a Constitution saving throw against the spell. On a successful save, the spell ends.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher slot, the Necrotic damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; the once-per-turn weapon-hit benefit heals the attacker, and the infected target saves after taking that Necrotic damage. No initial save is added.

source:
三株毒蘑菇在施法范围内你能看到的一处5尺空间内魔法性地发芽。蘑菇会释放有毒的孢子，并且任何生物若在长出蘑菇的区域周围10尺范围内开始回合，必须通过一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，则该生物将因每个蘑菇受到1d8点毒素伤害，并且直到它的下个回合开始前陷入中毒状态。
直到法术结束前，你可以在自己的回合用一个附赠动作让该区域内额外再长出来一个蘑菇。
升环施法效应：使用五环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比四环高一环，初始时区域内就会再多长出来一颗蘑菇。
target:
Three poisonous mushrooms magically sprout in a 5-foot space you can see within range. They release toxic spores. Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the area where the mushrooms grow must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d8 Poison damage for each mushroom and has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.
Until the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on your turn to grow one additional mushroom in that area.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher slot, one additional mushroom grows in the area initially for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; damage is per mushroom, and both damage and Poisoned depend on failure. The source specifies a 5-foot space without further dimensions; none are added.

你以你施法距离内能看到的一个生物为目标，将一道神圣之光照射在它们的身上。目标必须通过一次感知豁免。若豁免检定失败，目标将承受8d8点光耀伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。该法术对天界生物和构装生物无效。
如果法术以不死生物或邪魔为目标，它的豁免检定将承受劣势，并且法术将直接对其造成最大伤害。如果一个不死生物或邪魔因此法术生命值降低为0，该生物将死亡并且尸体会化为灰烬。

target:
You target one creature you can see within range and shine holy light upon it. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 8d8 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. This spell has no effect on Celestials or Constructs.
If the target is an Undead or Fiend, it has Disadvantage on the saving throw, and the spell deals maximum damage to it. If an Undead or Fiend drops to 0 Hit Points because of this spell, it dies and its body turns to ash.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher slot, you can choose one additional creature for each slot level above 4; the creatures must be 30 feet apart from one another.
note: Full passage translated. The source states maximum damage for Undead and Fiends alongside its general half-damage save rule without further explaining their interaction. Its extra-target spacing says 30 feet apart, not explicitly within 30 feet; that wording is retained rather than adding an inequality.

你选择范围内一个着甲或有天生护甲的生物。你魔法性地使这个生物的天生护甲或人造护甲在法术持续时间内变得腐朽和易碎。当它的护甲被腐蚀时，该生物的AC变为10+该生物的敏捷调整值。
升环施法效应：使用五环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比四环高一环，你就可以额外多选择一个目标。
target:
Choose a creature within range that wears armor or has natural armor. You magically make its natural or manufactured armor rotten and brittle for the duration. While its armor is corroded, the creature's AC becomes 10 + its Dexterity modifier.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher slot, you can choose one additional target for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; the source sets AC to a formula and specifies no saving throw. Neither an extra armor penalty nor a save is added.

source:
你从未来的自己处接收到一条最多6个单词的讯息，警告你即将面临的重大威胁，或指引你走向一条有望收获成果的道路。这条信息由DM决定。在未来的某个时刻，一旦你理解了自己为何发送这条讯息，你必须进行一次长达10分钟的仪式（可在短休或长休期间进行），将这条讯息送回过去传达给现在的你。若你施展该法术时未收到任何讯息，这意味着你在未来永远不会完成这个仪式——这可能是因为你的死亡，亦或遭遇了其他阻碍。
一旦你施展了此法术，在七天内或直到你完成仪式前，你都不能再次施展它。
context: column:M;spell:Dire Warning;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:4
target:
You receive a message of no more than 6 words from your future self, warning you of an imminent major threat or guiding you toward a potentially fruitful path. The DM determines the message. At some future point, once you understand why you sent it, you must perform a 10-minute ritual, which can take place during a Short or Long Rest, to send the message back to your present self. If you receive no message when you cast this spell, it means you will never complete that ritual in the future, perhaps because you die or encounter some other obstacle.
Once you cast this spell, you cannot cast it again for seven days or until you complete the ritual.
note: Full passage translated. The final source uses "for seven days or until the ritual" without saying which condition wins if their timing differs; the same ambiguity is retained. The message is at most six words, not six characters.

你触碰一只中型或更小的野兽，使其变形成一位外貌由你选择的类人。该野兽的属性资料会被平民Commoner的数据卡取代，但保留其生命值和生命值骰。你选择该平民的技能熟练。该平民会穿着高档服装，但没有其他装备，并且对所有非熟练任务有着基本的理解。
目标获得10临时生命值。如果目标的临时生命值耗尽，则法术提前结束。法术结束时，高档服装会化为烟雾消散。
战斗Combat。该平民是你与你的盟友的盟友。它掷出自己的先攻并在自己的回合行动。它的行为如同受你雇佣一样尽职尽责。
持续时间Duration。此法术的持续时间取决于施展的时间和地点。如果在时间正常流逝的地方施展，则法术会持续至下一个午夜的第十二下钟声鸣响，无论这段时间多长。在其他地方，法术持续24小时。

context: column:M;spell:Mandy's Feral Follower;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:4
target:
You touch a Medium or smaller Beast and transform it into a Humanoid whose appearance you choose. Its statistics are replaced by the Commoner stat block, but it retains its Hit Points and Hit Dice. You choose the Commoner's skill proficiencies. It wears Fine Clothes but has no other equipment and has a basic understanding of all unskilled tasks.
The target gains 10 Temporary Hit Points. The spell ends early if the target's Temporary Hit Points run out. When the spell ends, the Fine Clothes dissolve into smoke.
Combat. The Commoner is an ally to you and your allies. It rolls its own Initiative and acts on its own turn, working as diligently as if you had hired it.
Duration. The spell's duration depends on when and where you cast it. In a place where time passes normally, it lasts until the twelfth stroke of the next midnight, however long that takes. Elsewhere, it lasts 24 hours.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: You can transform one additional Beast for each slot level above 4.
note: Full passage translated; retained Hit Points and Hit Dice, chosen proficiencies, independent Initiative, and both duration cases are preserved. The Temporary Hit Point ending clause is not narrowed to a particular source.

source:
你尝试镇静施法距离内一个你能看见的生物。目标必须进行一次感知豁免。如果豁免失败，则该生物被你镇静直到法术结束。被镇静的生物无法发动攻击，无法施放影响敌人的法术，也无法对其他生物造成伤害。目标可以在其每个回合结束时重复进行豁免检定，豁免成功则效应终止。
升环施法。使用五环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比四环高一环，就可以额外影响一个目标。当你选择目标时，这些生物之间的距离必须在30尺以内。
target:
You attempt to calm one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is pacified by you until the spell ends. A pacified creature cannot make attacks, cast spells that affect enemies, or damage other creatures. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell with a level 5 or higher slot, you can affect one additional target for each slot level above 4. The creatures must be within 30 feet of one another when you choose them.
note: Full passage translated; pacification is described by the source's three restrictions, not replaced with Charmed or another standard condition. Target spacing is checked when selected.
